title: Private Skippered Charters in Puget Sound
includes: USCG Licensed Captain knowledgeable of the sites and area
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the stunning waters of Puget Sound with Windworks' Private Skippered Charters, for groups of 4 (minimum) up to 6 people. Or charter multiple boats for larger parties. No sailing experience is necessary; simply relax and enjoy the scenery or learn some basic skills like tacking and jibing and take the helm under the guidance of an experienced captain. Bring your favorite food and beverages. 

- Choose from a range of sailboats, 32 to 46 feet in length, all newer-models and based at Shilshole Bay Marina, Seattle
- Options for 3-hour and 6-hour private cruises available
- All safety gear provided, along with basic sailing instruction
- USCG Licensed Captain ensures a safe and enjoyable adventure
